name: elevenlabs
description: ElevenLabs: text to speech and sound effects saved as audio files, speech to text, voices, models, history and usage

nodes.title: Text to speech
nodes.description: Convert text to speech with a voice and save the audio file in ELEVENLABS_OUTPUT_DIR (billed per character)

voice_id.description: Voice id from list_voices, e.g. JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb

model_id.description: Model id from list_models (API default eleven_multilingual_v2), e.g. eleven_flash_v2_5, eleven_v3

language_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code to enforce, for models that support it

voice_settings.description: Overrides the voice's settings: {stability 0-1, similarity_boost 0-1, style, use_speaker_boost, speed}

previous_text.description: Text before this one, for continuity when splitting long text

next_text.description: Text after this one, for continuity when splitting long text

apply_text_normalization.description: Spell out numbers and abbreviations (default auto)

output_format.description: Audio format codec_samplerate_bitrate (API default mp3_44100_128; 192 kbps MP3 and 44.1 kHz PCM need Creator/Pro plans)

enable_logging.description: false enables zero retention mode (enterprise only): no history item is kept

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Generate sound effect
nodes.description: Generate a sound effect from a text description and save the audio file in ELEVENLABS_OUTPUT_DIR (billed per generation)

text.description: Description of the sound, e.g. 'glass shattering on concrete'

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds (default: chosen from the prompt)

prompt_influence.description: How closely to follow the prompt (default 0.3)

output_format.description: Audio format codec_samplerate_bitrate (API default mp3_44100_128; 192 kbps MP3 and 44.1 kHz PCM need Creator/Pro plans)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Speech to text
nodes.description: Transcribe an audio or video file (exactly one of file: an https URL or a file inside ELEVENLABS_UPLOAD_DIR, or source_url) with word timestamps, speaker diarization and audio-event tags (billed per hour of audio)

file.description: Audio or video file to upload (up to 100 MB here); or use source_url (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

source_url.description: https URL of the media that ElevenLabs fetches itself (also YouTube/TikTok links); instead of file

language_code.description: ISO 639-1/639-3 language code; detected when omitted

diarize.description: Label which speaker is talking (default false)

keyterms.description: Words or phrases to bias recognition towards

enable_logging.description: false enables zero retention mode (enterprise only): no history item is kept

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Clone voice
nodes.description: Create an instant voice clone from an audio sample (https URL or a file inside ELEVENLABS_UPLOAD_DIR); you must have the speaker's consent

sample.description: Audio sample of the speaker (1-2 minutes of clean speech works best) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

labels.description: Labels as a JSON object string, e.g. {"accent":"british"}

remove_background_noise.description: Remove background noise from the sample (default false)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
